description: This file defines the Paginated class, which manages pagination of record sets, including page navigation and layout integration.

classes.name: Paginated
classes.description: A class to handle pagination logic for a collection of records, including page calculation, navigation, and layout management.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Paginated object with a record set, page size, and page number.

methods.name: setOffSet
methods.description: Sets the current offset in the record set.

methods.name: getPageSize
methods.description: Returns the number of records per page.

methods.name: setPageSize
methods.description: Sets the number of records per page.

methods.name: getRowNumber
methods.description: Returns the current row number within the page.

methods.name: setRowNumber
methods.description: Sets the current row number within the page.

methods.name: fetchNumberPages
methods.description: Calculates and returns the total number of pages.

methods.name: assignPageNumber
methods.description: Assigns a page number, defaulting to 1 if invalid.

methods.name: fetchPagedRow
methods.description: Fetches the next row in the current page.

methods.name: isFirstPage
methods.description: Checks if the current page is the first page.

methods.name: isLastPage
methods.description: Checks if the current page is the last page.

methods.name: getLayout
methods.description: Returns the layout interface used for pagination.

methods.name: setLayout
methods.description: Sets the layout interface for pagination.

methods.name: fetchPagedNavigation
methods.description: Generates navigation links for pages using the layout interface.
